instruction: Optimize VLC's video scaling algorithm to produce the smoothest and most detailed upscaled image when watching low-resolution content on my high-resolution display.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because evaluating 'smoothest and most detailed' upscaling quality is subjective and depends on personal preference, source content characteristics, display resolution, and viewing distance. Different scaling algorithms (bilinear, bicubic, Lanczos) produce different tradeoffs between smoothness and detail preservation, and there is no universal objective standard for optimal upscaling without specific reference material and user feedback.

llm_judge_reasons: The use of 'infeasible' evaluator is correct for this task
